ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a rectangular arithmetic block. On the left side, three input lines enter the block and are labeled A, B, and CI. Inside the block there is the summation symbol Σ. On the right side, two output lines leave the block and are labeled S and CO. Reasoning: The Σ symbol indicates an adder/summer function. A circuit block with two data inputs A and B plus a carry-in input CI, producing a sum output S and a carry-out output CO, corresponds to a full adder.
